## Checklist

- [ ] The line in `FEATURES.md` is moved forward (or added)
- [ ] `docs/COVERAGE.md` is updated if a backend can do something new, or can no longer do it faithfully
- [ ] A test shows the new behaviour (and a scenario in `scenarios/` where it is about the network)
- [ ] A decision that is hard to undo has an entry in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] The documentation is updated (README, docs, examples)
